answer: A hardware attestation protocol limits Sybil attacks by executing agent logic inside an enclave haven. Identities are validated by a silicon-rooted cryptographic quill that signs runtime state. To forge multiple identities, an attacker must acquire scarce physical secure chips rather than virtualizing instances. A zephyr auditing service continuously verifies these hardware credentials. However, this design depends on centralized silicon vendors and remains vulnerable to side-channel leakage.
